Name: Bloodburn Bonus
Desc: Lower <color=#ffdd93>remaining HP</color> grants a greater <color=#ffdd93>total DMG Bonus</color>.

Name: Healing Assault
Desc: <color=#ffdd93>Extra DMG Bonus</color> increases for 20s after <color=#ffdd93>healing</color> other players.

Name: Shield Slam Boost
Desc: Increases <color=#ffdd93>Extra DMG Bonus</color> while <color=#ffdd93>shielded</color> and for 3 seconds after <color=#ffdd93>the shield disappears</color>.

Name: Support DMG Reduction
Desc: <color=#ffdd93>DMG Reduction</color> increases while <color=#ffdd93>reviving other players</color>.

Name: CRIT DMG Buff
Desc: When ATK Amplification ≥50%, <color=#ffdd93>CRIT DMG</color> increases.

Name: Absolute Advantage
Desc: When HP ≥16000, <color=#ffdd93>CRIT DMG</color> increases.

Name: Wrath Strike
Desc: Deals more <color=#ffdd93>Extra DMG</color> against enemies in <color=#ffdd93>Wrath</color> state.

Name: Imbalance Specialist
Desc: Deals more <color=#ffdd93>Extra DMG</color> against enemies in <color=#ffdd93>Imbalanced</color> state.

Name: Miraculous Survival
Desc: Triggers <color=#ffdd93>Auto Revival</color> when dying. Can trigger again after <color=#ffdd93>cooldown</color> ends.

Name: Bloodburn Assault
Desc: Increases <color=#ffdd93>ATK Amplification</color> but reduces Max HP by 20%.

Name: Victory Pursuit
Desc: Higher <color=#ffdd93>remaining HP</color> grants a greater <color=#ffdd93>total DMG Bonus</color>.

Name: Thunder Brand
Desc: [Crimson Weave]'s [Wildfire Slash], [Shadow Strike], and [Thunderous Bash] all gain a <color=#ffdd93>DMG bonus</color>. [Lucia: Crimson Weave]'s attacks have a chance to leave [Wounds] on enemies. Up to 5 [Wounds] can exist. When [Wildfire Slash] deals DMG, detonates all [Wounds] to call down <color=#ffdd93>lightning strikes that deal Extra DMG</color>.

Name: Ashen Memory
Desc: [Crimson Weave]'s [swordwaves] and [Swordwave Attack] gain a <color=#ffdd93>DMG bonus</color>. When casting [Swordwave Attack], heals for 0.5% Max HP. When attacking targets with [Swordbreak Marks], deals additional Swordbreak DMG without consuming [Swordbreak Mark stacks]. This effect can trigger once every 0.5s.

Name: Chain Blaze
Desc: When casting [Whirling Thrash], [Crimson Weave] gains interruption resistance. When [Whirling Thrash] deals DMG, gains a <color=#ffdd93>DMG bonus</color> and increases the <color=#ffdd93>max DMG</color>.

Name: Void Sheath
Desc: When [Crimson Weave] casts [Iaido Slash β] while holding a movement button, triggers [Dash Iaido] and returns to the original casting position. When [Iaido Slash β] is cast, gains a <color=#ffdd93>DMG bonus</color>.

Name: Void Silence
Desc: When [Crimson Weave] casts [Splashing Thunder], <color=#ffdd93>DMG bonus</color> and <color=#ffdd93>Extra DMG Reduction</color> gained are enhanced.

Name: Arc Scar
Desc: When casting [Thunderous Bash], [Alpha: Crimson] Weave leaves fissures on the ground. <color=#ffdd93>Fissures</color> deal DMG to targets within range once per second for 8s.

Name: Radiant Guard
Desc: When [Startrail] performs a Block Counter, she gains increased <color=#ffdd93>Extra DMG Reduction</color>, and the Block Counter gains a <color=#ffdd93>DMG bonus</color>. When a Perfect Block is performed in [Sword & Shield] State and [Starcore Value] is full, press and hold Basic Attack to cast [Meteoric Doom].

Name: Stellar Focus
Desc: While in [Shield & Axe State], [Startrail] gains interruption resistance, <color=#ffdd93>Extra DMG Reduction</color>, and an increased <color=#ffdd93>Imbalance buff</color>. When enemies are Imbalanced, gains a <color=#ffdd93>DMG bonus</color> for 15s. If in <color=#ffdd93>[Mad Dissection] Form</color>, extends the duration of the bonus to 60s.

Name: Jet Boost
Desc: When [Startrail] casts [Comet Burst], increases [Comet Burst]'s movement distance, and activates Block detection during the cast. Can be cast using the joystick.

Name: Cosmic Edge
Desc: For 10s after [Startrail] casts [Aetherstrike] or [Prismatic Thrust], increases the efficiency of gaining [Starcore Value], [Infinitas Value], and [Sharpness Value], and gains <color=#ffdd93>DMG Bonus</color>. Reduces the <color=#ffdd93>cooldown</color> of [Aetherstrike] and [Prismatic Thrust]. While casting either skill, gains interruption resistance and <color=#ffdd93>Extra DMG Reduction</color>.

Name: Guided Focus
Desc: After [Startrail] casts [Splashing Thunder], <color=#ffdd93>Aggro Focus</color> increases whenever she deals DMG. For a period of time, attacking taunted enemies deals <color=#ffdd93>one additional instance of DMG</color>. This effect can trigger at most once per second.

Name: Unfurled Stars
Desc: When [Startrail] performs the 3rd hit of [Wandering Starburst] while in [Sword & Shield] state, tap [Thunderflare Storm] to gain an Enhanced Combo Strike and a large amount of [Sharpness Value].

Name: Sacred Hymn
Desc: At max [Chant Stacks], [Empyrea] enhances the next [Nighttime Prayer] and [Azure Firmament]. Enhanced [Nighttime Prayer] and [Azure Firmament] will heal other players while <color=#ffdd93>additionally restoring HP to all players</color>.

Name: Divine Decree
Desc: When [Empyrea]'s [Radiant Judgment II] strikes an enemy with its final hit, creates an additional <color=#ffdd93>explosion</color> and gains 2 [Chant Stacks].

Name: Final Verdict
Desc: After casting [Crimson Crown], [Empyrea] enters [Empyreal Form].

Name: Sacred Dawn
Desc: After casting [Empyreal Oath], [Empyrea] gains a <color=#ffdd93>healing buff</color> for 20s and casts [Nighttime Prayer] once.

Name: Absolution Turn
Desc: When a boss in [Wrath Form] casts high-threat skills, immediately refreshes [Azure Firmament] and gains 12 [Chant Stacks].

Name: Devout Chant
Desc: When [Empyrea] enters [Empyreal Form], reduces cooldown by 33% for [Nighttime Prayer], [Azure Firmament], and [Crimson Crown].
